shared: You keep a water Level across turns; it reaches both boards, so it can hurt your own units.
differ: What the water does: chips front-row Health, sets every unit's shared Health, or halves sunk units' Attack.

takes.label: Front-row flood
takes.line: Before attacks, both front rows lose a tenth of their Health per Level; you seat floaters and neighbour-shielding beavers to stay dry.
takes.look_if: a front-row seating puzzle, with water that hurts big units too.

takes.label: One shared Health
takes.line: Every Board unit has the same Health, a Pool split by seats filled, so each buy asks: three walls or seven attackers?
takes.look_if: a wide-or-tall choice on every buy, with other tribes paying in.

takes.label: Scout, then vote
takes.line: Your Level plus your opponent's sets the water; units below it hit at half Attack, so you scout, then raise or lower.
takes.look_if: to tune the water to each opponent you scout.
